prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity flat desktop application screenshot, 1440×1000 composition, crisp legible English UI text in Geist sans-serif. Edit the supplied current Workbench screenshot into a proposed state. Input image is the incumbent visual and composition reference, not content to reproduce blindly. Keep restrained T3code-like continuous chat, dark warm charcoal (#201e22) opaque background, slightly lighter composer (#28262b), pale near-white text, muted grey metadata, restrained lavender signature/selection only. Preserve // Workbench identity, company CCC Intelligent Solutions · CCCS, subdued user bubble, quiet unboxed assistant prose, compact bottom anchored composer, generous reading measure, and independent floating context card OPEN at upper right. Card has Plan, Outputs, Sources; it belongs to the dossier, never attach references to messages. No permanent right rail; floating card does not overlap main reading column. Remove the gallery's top preview/debug toolbar completely. In the top app header show // Workbench, company label, discreet 'Illustrative' disclosure and context icon. No marketing, gradients on background, glass decoration, giant headings, browser chrome, laptop frame, purple-filled cards or unrelated sidebars. Main chat column left-center about 740px wide; right floating card about 300px. Use realistic concise exact English copy below. Small icons drawn as consistent thin line icons. Copy controls are icon-only and timestamp appears beside copy on hovered message. This is a design proposal image, not a claim of actual research or real evidence. Preserve the important launch treatment: rounded pale subtly shaded 'Start research →' button for explicit commitment, visually stronger than secondary controls.
STATE 3: ONE CLARIFICATION QUESTION AT A TIME, ANSWERED THROUGH THE SAME COMPOSER.
Edit the current screenshot into this state. Single complete desktop application screenshot. This is a materially necessary clarification before the proposed research program, NOT one of its research questions. Remove the entire proposed-framing panel, research-question list, launch button and activity summary from the reference screenshot.
Top transcript: neutral user bubble "I want to understand CCC's exposure to agent-led claims." Unboxed assistant prose "One point would help me focus the research. You can use the suggested scope or describe another."
At bottom, attach ONE contextual question panel directly to ONE composer. The combined surface should take about bottom 300-350px, with calm compact typography. Small panel header "Clarify the scope", progress indicator "1 of 2" at right. Actual question in medium-weight reading size: "Which part of the claims workflow should we focus on?"
Three vertically arranged selectable rows, each with subtle radio circle and optional number shortcut:
1 "Photo-led auto claims" with smaller description "Suggested · A concrete workflow connecting insurers and repairers."
2 "Repair network management" with smaller description "Focus on participation, assignment and coordination."
3 "Broader company exposure" with smaller description "Keep the initial scope open."
First option is visibly selected with a thin muted lavender contour, not a saturated purple block. Exactly one question shown; do not display question 2 or a research plan behind it.
The SAME main composer below has placeholder "Or describe a different scope…". Its input area is compact, because no text has been entered. A narrow attached action line at bottom right "Next question →"; no send-arrow duplicate. Question progress and next action belong to the clarification, not Start research.
Keep open top-right floating context card: title "CCCS · Research"; section Plan "Scope being clarified"; section Outputs "No outputs yet"; section Sources "Investor day 2025 deck". No bogus completed research work.
Style has quiet thin separators, opaque matte surfaces, comfortable legibility, no panel explosion, no modal overlay, no browser chrome, no arrows outside the UI, no annotation captions. Illustrative disclosure visible.
purpose: One discussed proposal, illustrated across its states; not competing compositions
